title: SetEdgeExistenceInterval payload
description: Typed payload for the set-edge-existence-interval operation kind (registry code 11). Modify an edge's existence interval without changing its endpoints; may carry a tombstone flag. The payload shape here is the canonical contract for this op kind; the implementation is built to it. Encoded per the canonical-JSON profile: all fields present, absent optionals as null, UUIDs lower-case hyphenated, HLC and valid times as decimal strings, layer as a stable lower name.

is_tombstone.description: When true, suppresses the edge from this valid_from within its layer (supersession, not erasure).

hlc.description: Full-range HLC coordinate as a decimal string (canonical-JSON profile).

validTime.description: ValidTime as epoch microseconds UTC, encoded as a decimal string.

layer.description: Layer value tag as a stable schema-owned lower name.
